text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED — Severity: P1. Smart-routing oscillation detected across regions (us-east-1 <-> us-west-2 <-> eu-west-1). Auto-detected by routing-telemetry. Pager routed to SRE oncall. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

Alicia Chen: paging SRE oncall — seeing burst of 502s and request timeouts across multiple customers. Latency tail spikes, some requests get retried repeatedly. @oncall-sre please pick up. :rotating_light:

Samir Patel: I'm on it, looking at control-plane logs. Initial signal looks like health-check flapping on regional proxies causing fallback churn.

Maya Song: Customer impact: AcmeCorp reports timeouts, retries; EduLabs seeing degraded throughput. Will quantify SLA exposure once we stabilize.

Ben Ortiz: Observed pattern: request flows bouncing east->west->eu->east within seconds. KV cache misses on each hop causing token regeneration and extra downstream load. Cost + latency both spike.

Priya Rao: mlops-bot shows fallback policy picked a quantized variant 'small-quant-v2' as fallback in us-west; those instances fail probe after initialization (503/timeout) which then triggers another fallback -> loop.

mlops-bot: ALERT: variant-incompatibility detected. fallback_variant='small-quant-v2' init_error=SIGTERM_on_load region=us-west-2 probe_status=UNHEALTHY

Samir Patel: logs snippet for context:
```
2026-03-15T09:13:21Z route=rs-az1 probe=health-check status=UNHEALTHY target=redwood-1-small-quant instance=i-023abc
2026-03-15T09:13:23Z route=rs-az1 action=fallback target=us-west-2 variant=small-quant-v2
2026-03-15T09:13:25Z route=rs-az2 probe=HEALTHY -> UNHEALTHY
2026-03-15T09:13:26Z routing: forwarded request id=tx-9f3 east->west->eu
```
Samir Patel: hypothesis: health-check debounce too aggressive (short window) + incompatible fallback variant causes rapid flip-flop.

Alicia Chen: Action plan (short term):
1) Temporarily disable cross-region fallback policy to stop oscillation.
2) Increase regional probe debounce from 2s -> 30s.
3) Pin high-traffic customers (AcmeCorp, EduLabs) to us-east stable variant.
4) Revert fallback variant for us-west to 'redwood-1-base-v1'.
5) Scale us-east pool by +2 nodes for headroom.

Samir Patel: I'll flip routing.policy.cross_region_fallback=false now and bump debounce. Executing in infra console.

deploy-bot: deploy started: routing-config v2026-03-15-09:14 (user=samir)

deploy-bot: deploy success: routing-config v2026-03-15-09:14 applied to control-plane (change_id=rc-20260315-001)

Samir Patel: change rolled. Confirmed policy disabled; cross-region fallback suppressed.

Maya Song: telemetry: error-rate for AcmeCorp down 7.2% -> 1.1% in last 10m, p95 latency improving. :thumbsup:

Ben Ortiz: I'm reverting fallback variant in us-west to base: executing mlops rollback.

mlops-bot: Command acknowledged. Run:
```
/mlops rollback-variant --region us-west-2 --model redwood-1 --variant redwood-1-base-v1
```

Priya Rao: rollback executed, instances recycled with base variant. Health probes now passing.

Alicia Chen: Handoff: I'm handing on-call to Ben Ortiz at 09:35 UTC. Ben, please own the watch and run a 30m canary once things look stable.

Ben Ortiz: ack, taking over. I'll keep verbose logs for 1h and run canary traffic to validate no more cross-region churn.

Maya Song: Customer comms: Sent interim updates to AcmeCorp and EduLabs SEs with mitigation summary and ETA for postmortem.

incident-bot: Severity downgraded to P2 per incident criteria (customer impact reduced; key mitigations in place).

Alicia Chen: Follow-ups (post-incident):
- Increase default probe debounce on regional proxies to 15s (config review).
- Add rollout guard: block fallback to quantized variants unless compatibility test passes in staging region.
- Add alert: unusual cross-region routing spike > 5% above baseline.
- Run tabletop for routing policy failover scenarios.

Ben Ortiz: I'll own the postmortem and action tracking. Owner: Ben Ortiz. Target postmortem date: 2026-03-16 16:00 UTC.

Priya Rao: Verbose traces will be retained for 48h and then auto-sampled.

Samir Patel: Adding a quick config snippet we used to disable fallback:
```
routing.policy:
  cross_region_fallback: false
  probe_debounce_seconds: 30
```

Alicia Chen: Thanks team. If anything new shows up, ping @oncall-sre and reopen thread. Closing this thread for now — continuing follow-up in the incident board. :white_check_mark:

oncall-sre: noted, continuing monitoring.
